name: Accelerated Charged Particle Array Gun
description: The ACP Array Gun, or Accelerated Charged Particle Array Gun, was a weapon best suited to close range combat. The gun was favored by some Trandoshans during the Clone Wars and Imperial Era. The pirate Kragan Gorr used a customized ACP Array Gun during the New Republic Era when he and his gang worked for the First Order. Although he lost this weapon after his mutiny on the Colossus.
